translations.10: Lunch is eaten with the team members
translations.12: On the second day, we spend the whole day on-site.
translations.13: Unloading operations will be observed while wearing safety shoes.
translations.14: Do not approach a driver who is currently working.
translations.15: The experience report will be submitted to the team leader for approval.
translations.16: Once confirmed, it will be delivered to Manager 변준호.
translations.18: New employees at Moalogis proceed through a task list called 'Launchpad' in their first week.
translations.19: Launchpad task #1 is logging into the Wiki and joining the company messenger.
translations.20: Company-wide announcements and small talk take place in the 'Hearth' channel.
translations.21: Leave a short self-introduction at the campfire.
translations.22: Step 2 is to take the Dispatch System Guide training.
translations.23: As a guide, you will try creating a full day's dispatch plan yourself.
translations.24: Do not put the practice screen on the campfire.
translations.25: You don't have to write long reports.
translations.26: Once you finish all the stepping stones, you will start practical work from the second week.
translations.27: The first practical task is receiving a code review with Eom Seo-jin.
translations.28: The code review results will be shared in Modakbul's team channel.
translations.29: If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Manager Junho Byeon.
translations.3: This document guides you through what to do in order during your first 2 weeks ▶
translations.30: Lastly, just leave a one-line thought about the bonfire and you're done.
translations.4: For inquiries, please contact HR Manager Joonho Byun (변준호).
translations.5: Seojin Um (엄서진) will help you with the development environment setup.
translations.7: When you arrive at work, first receive your access pass at the 1st floor information desk.
translations.8: The pass you received will be registered by Manager Junho Byeon.
translations.9: The seat is next to the dawn team, and Seojin Eom will also sit in the same row.
